sources.title: GitHub - beltromatti/cartpole-drl: A Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent trained ...
sources.snippet: This project trains a DQN agent to balance a pole on a cart using the CartPole-v1 environment. The agent learns through experience replay and an epsilon-greedy policy, with periodic visualization and model checkpointing.

sources.title: GitHub - haardik06/CartPole-Reinforcement-Learning-DQN: Deep ...
sources.snippet: This project implements a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent using PyTorch to solve the CartPole-v1 environment from Gymnasium. The agent learns to balance a pole on a moving cart by interacting with the environment and maximizing cumulative rewards.

sources.title: sb3/dqn-CartPole-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a DQN agent playing CartPole-v1 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.
